title: What’s new in image understanding
description: Unlock powerful image understanding with the latest Vision framework and Foundation Models framework updates. The new tap-to-segment request lets you segment images in new ways, and Vision now supports watchOS. Combine the new image support in Apple Foundation Model together with OCR, barcode scanning and your own tools to deliver LLM-powered visual understanding in your app.
